mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sale_amount), 0) AS saleAmount, COALESCE(SUM(order_count), 0) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(product_count), 0) AS productCount FROM sales_realtime_agg WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND stat_minute >= CURDATE()

SELECT stat_minute AS statMinute, SUM(sale_amount) AS saleAmount, SUM(order_count) AS orderCount FROM sales_realtime_agg WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND stat_minute >= #{startTime} GROUP BY stat_minute ORDER BY stat_minute

SELECT product_id AS productId, MAX(product_name) AS productName, MAX(category) AS category, SUM(pay_amount) AS saleAmount, SUM(quantity) AS saleQuantity FROM sales_detail WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND pay_minute >= CURDATE() GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY saleAmount DESC LIMIT #{topN}
